text_block_list.text:
Before training. While waiting for Neo 
Universe—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I-It's just fiction... It's sci-fi, after 
all. There's no way aliens actually 
exist...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Interested in "aliens"...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Gyah!? Ah... N-No, that's not it! Um, I 
was talking about a movie...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Actually... the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Special Forces
text_block_list.text:
"Mayday, mayday! An unidentified creature 
has breached the facility! Requesting 
backup immediately— Hey, stop— Gwaaaagh!!"

text_block_list.name: Alien
text_block_list.text: “Kishaaaah!!”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Because even if I know it's fiction, 
the creepy stuff still gives me the 
chills...!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"CONT"... In the first place, for "aliens" 
to find Earth is... an "astronomical 
probability."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Is that so?

Come to think of it, I remember a TV show 
or something comparing the size of the 
galaxy to something else. If the galaxy 
were the Kanto Plain, the sun would be 2 
meters across, and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"The Earth is that small?! Then Hokkaido 
must be even smaller...?!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You mean... it's like looking for a piece 
of mechanical pencil lead in the middle of 
the Kanto Plain...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. However, the study of 
"aliens"—extraterrestrial intelligent 
lifeforms— is filled with fascinating 
discoveries.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
In this galaxy, it's said there are 3,500 
fixed stars— and stars similar to our sun 
among them.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"ASEM"—There is also a possibility that an 
Earth-like planet nearby has built a 
similar civilization.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying there might be races like 
the Twinkle Series on other planets, and 
even Umamusume there too?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If you "receive" a signal from an 
"alien"... "Connecting" on your own is a 
"no-go." You report it to research 
facilities or the UN, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You've even set up rules? Even adults take 
things surprisingly seriously, don't 
they...
choice_data_list:
It might not just be something that 
happens in the movies.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aliens really might exist, huh~. If it's 
possible to meet one, I kind of want to!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Well, as long as we can have an 
intellectual discussion. I suppose that 
wouldn't be so bad, would it?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...! I'm "happy"... that you're 
interested.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
And also— there's the "zoo hypothesis" 
about "aliens."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""INTI"... The theory that "aliens" are 
"observing" Earth as it builds its 
civilization."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Already, "contact" with Earthlings—— Neo 
Universe and the others are in a cage... 
How 'thrilling.'

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean, um... sci-fi is actually 
real!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Nooo! G-Give me a break from that, 
pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: Looks like I should follow them

It was going so well up until the middle, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Covering for them... Hmm. There's 'no' 
reason to attack the zoo.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Even sooooo--!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If the goal is observation, there 
shouldn't be any interference. ...Only the 
bare minimum.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: This is getting a bit unsettling--!!

Though she couldn't quite smooth things 
over... seeing her chat so lively with her 
two juniors was somehow heartwarming.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Negative... A discrepancy in fields of 
interest. A "failure".

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, this turned out to be a good 
opportunity. In fact, I'm going to 
research everything there is about 
space...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"It's only scary because you're an unknown 
entity! Once I get to know you, it'll be 
nothing! Universe-san, please talk to me 
again!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Affirmative! You showed interest in 
'space,' which is 'happy.'

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, yes! Then I'd love to learn about 
planets that have tons of food!

Neo Universe is flanked by the two of 
them. Seeing how happy she looks, even 
from behind, warmed my heart as well.
